objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Specific procedures within a framework and process sequence with details and responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed work steps and special procedures for sub-processes with forms and checklists

objs.name: document
objs.description: A general information object that can be created, edited, and released in the system

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed amendment to a document created without affecting the document's version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check and extend the validity of a document

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and reactivate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups or persons assigned to receive document release notifications or acknowledgement requests

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with documents in various roles

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned to specific roles and permissions

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new information object with selection of document type and template

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes in categories

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the content of a document using an editing client based on source format

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a document to PDF format for web display

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add a non-controlled document attachment to a document

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled document attachment subject to the release cycle

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a proposed amendment to a document without affecting version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule and implement a change proposal into a new document version

evts.name: sign_by_author
evts.description: Author signs to confirm document creation with electronic signature

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects

evts.name: sign_by_reviewer
evts.description: Reviewer signs to confirm completion of review with electronic signature

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: Releaser signs to confirm document release with electronic signature

evts.name: sign_by_releaser
evts.description: Releaser signs to confirm approval with electronic signature

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release to make it visible to readers

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check and validate translated document content

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Releaser signs to confirm translation release

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new version when content or critical attributes change

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving when it is no longer relevant to a new version

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request 30 days before document validity expires

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm validity extension by releaser or through multi-step workflow

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document as out of force and archive it

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request to re-validate an archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate and restore an archived document to active status

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of a distributed document

evts.name: notify_distribution_by_email
evts.description: Automatically send email notification to distribution list on document release

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request workflow-supported acknowledgement from distribution list

o2o.description: Document can have associated Additional Info attachments
Document can have associated Attachments that are released with it
Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed in a Document
Validity Extension Request is linked to a Document for checking
Override Request references a Document to be invalidated
Reactivation Request selects a Document to be reactivated
Guidelines can reference Policies as company-wide regulations
Procedural Instructions implement the framework defined by Guidelines
Work Instructions provide detailed steps for procedures
User is a member of a User Group
Distribution List contains assigned User Groups

o2e.description: Create Document event creates a Document object
Edit Document Properties event modifies Document metadata
Edit Document Content event modifies Document content
Convert Document to PDF event transforms Document format
Add Additional Info event creates an Additional Info object
Add Attachment event creates an Attachment object
Create Change Proposal event creates a Change Proposal object
Implement Change Proposal event schedules a Change Proposal
Sign by Author event documents Author signature on Document
Review Document event processes Document content review
Sign by Reviewer event documents Reviewer signature on Document
Approve Document event confirms Document release
Sign by Releaser event documents Releaser signature on Document
Publish Document event makes Document visible to readers
Translate Document event creates language version of Document
Review Translation event validates translated Document content
Approve Translation event confirms translation Document release
Create New Version event generates new Document version
Archive Attachment event marks Attachment for archiving
Create Validity Extension Request event generates Validity Extension Request
Extend Validity event updates Document validity period
Create Override Request event generates Override Request
Override Document event invalidates and archives Document
Create Reactivation Request event generates Reactivation Request
Reactivate Document event re-validates archived Document
Confirm Acknowledgement event documents User acknowledgement
Notify Distribution by Email event sends notification to Distribution List
Request Acknowledgement event requests acknowledgement from Distribution List
